answer: The air in the cellar grew thick with the scent of rot and old blood. Malakor’s eyes, burning with a cold, violet fury, fixed on the trembling smuggler. "You think you can simply walk away? After I gave you sanctuary? After I fed your starving family?" The man’s voice was a low, dangerous growl. "You are a rat, and rats deserve the trap. I will not just kill you. I will peel the skin from your bones, inch by inch, while you scream for a mercy that does not exist. You are mine, and I will make you regret the day you drew your first breath. Now, speak, or suffer the silence of the grave."
